headline: Infosys AI revenue up 29% sequentially, 10.5% of total; guidance cut
quote: Infosys’ AI revenue grew 29% sequentially in the September quarter, accounting for 10.5% of total revenue
claim: AIM reported on 23 Oct 2026 that Infosys's AI revenue grew 29% sequentially in the September quarter to 10.5% of total revenue, while the company cut its FY27 constant-currency revenue growth guidance to 1%-2% from 1.5%-3%. Infosys also reported $5.2 billion of large-deal contract value, including a mega deal of over $2 billion.
why_it_matters: Indian IT is a big campus employer; AI is 10.5% of Infosys revenue while the growth outlook was cut, so watch what AI work they hire for.
title: Infosys AI Revenue Rises 29% in Q2, FY27 Growth Guidance Cut

headline: Kamath says AI funding gap will make 2027 raises harder
quote: So if somebody is able to raise a lot of capital today and keep it, probably not a bad idea.
claim: In an NDTV World Summit interview streamed on 22 Oct 2026, Nikhil Kamath said roughly a trillion dollars a year is going into AI against maybe $100 to $200 billion coming out through enterprises, that money will become harder to get than it has been this year or last, and that raising capital now and keeping it is 'probably not a bad idea'. He rated the odds low that an Indian company can compete at the frontier-model layer, saw an opportunity in inference on open-source models, and said he would build at the application or services layers.
why_it_matters: Kamath expects capital to get harder in 2027 and sees India's opening in AI applications and inference, not frontier models; useful for planning a startup or internship.
title: Transcript: Nikhil Kamath Interview at NDTV World Summit 2026 – The Singju Post

headline: Different emerges from stealth with $48 Mn seed; AI leads weekly funding
quote: Ajeet Sing-led AI powered martech startup Different emerged from stealth and raised $48 Mn, the biggest cheque for an AI startup this week.
claim: Ajeet Sing-led AI martech startup Different came out of stealth with a $48 Mn seed round led by General Catalyst, with Lightspeed Venture Partners also investing (22 Oct 2026). Inc42 counted AI startups as the top sector for 19-23 Oct, raising $93.9 Mn across six deals out of over $184 Mn across 17 startup deals.
why_it_matters: AI took about half of the week's Indian startup funding; applied-AI teams, not model labs, are getting the big seed cheques.
title: Indian Startups Raised Over $184 Mn This Week

headline: Nilekani-anchored F2A gets ₹3,000 crore subscriptions for AI fund
quote: It recently secured ₹3,000 crore in subscriptions for its growth-stage AI and deeptech fund.
claim: Fundamentum Frontier Advisors (F2A), led by Ashish Kumar and anchored by Nandan Nilekani, has secured ₹3,000 crore in subscriptions for its growth-stage AI and deeptech fund, and its limited partners approved raising the hard cap to ₹3,500 crore. It expects to back 12-15 companies with cheques of ₹100 crore to ₹200 crore, about 40% in physical AI, 40% in digital consumer companies using AI and 20% in enterprise tools.
why_it_matters: Fresh domestic capital for growth-stage physical AI, semiconductors, robotics and enterprise AI, with ₹100-200 crore cheques, points to where Indian deeptech roles and startups may grow.
title: Why Nandan Nilekani-Backed F2A Believes India's Investment Opportunity Lies in Edge AI

headline: Karnataka-ElevenLabs voice AI MoU irks Indian startups
quote: ElevenLabs recently signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS) to explore using voice AI in Kannada
claim: AIM reported on 19 Oct 2026 that Indian voice AI startups are unhappy that ElevenLabs signed an MoU with the Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society to explore Kannada voice AI for citizen services, skilling and grievance redressal. The article says India is ElevenLabs' second-largest market outside the US, with more than 250 businesses and enterprises using it and 100 million conversations on ElevenAgents over the past year.
why_it_matters: Indian-language voice AI is contested ground: Indian businesses logged 100 million ElevenAgents conversations in a year, while local startups argue for Indian vendors on price and data sovereignty.
title: Karnataka’s ElevenLabs Partnership Irks Indian Voice AI Startups

headline: AuxoAI raises $20.7 Mn Series A led by NTTVC
quote: AuxoAI raised $20.7 million in a Series A round led by NTTVC, the Silicon Valley venture firm backed by Japan's NTT.
claim: AuxoAI raised a $20.7 million Series A led by NTTVC on 21 Oct 2026, with angel investors George Still Jr., Amit Zavery and Giacomo Sonnino taking part. Its AI strategists and engineers work alongside client staff, and its clients include UKG and Fogo de Chão.
why_it_matters: AuxoAI's engineers work alongside client staff to build AI systems; services-style AI work embedded with customers is drawing venture money, a route for builders who like customer work.
title: Daily Indian Funding Roundup & Key News - 21 October 2026: AuxoAI Raises $20.7 Million, Jio Platforms Opens ₹30,213 Crore IPO

headline: Peak XV-backed Blacksmith raises $66 Mn Series C at $1 Bn valuation
quote: San Francisco-based AI code testing startup Blacksmith has raised $66 Mn in a Series C funding round led by Sequoia Capital
claim: San Francisco-based AI code-testing startup Blacksmith raised a $66 Mn Series C led by Sequoia Capital, with Premji Invest and existing investors Peak XV Partners, Google Ventures and Y Combinator also participating, at a $1 Bn valuation. Inc42 says that doubled its $550 Mn valuation from the $45 Mn Series B that Peak XV led in August.
why_it_matters: Blacksmith's weekly CI jobs rose from 5 Mn to over 90 Mn since January as AI writes more code; testing that code is a funded problem.
title: AI Startup Blacksmith Nets $66 Mn At A Unicorn Valuation

headline: Hunar.AI raises Rs 39.3 crore Series A led by Blume
quote: Bengaluru-based conversational AI startup Hunar.AI has raised Rs 39.3 crore in a Series A funding round led by Blume Ventures
claim: Bengaluru-based Hunar.AI raised Rs 39.3 crore in a Series A led by Blume Ventures, which invested Rs 29 crore, according to reports citing regulatory filings. Its conversational AI agents automate recruitment, onboarding, training and workforce engagement for employers of frontline workers, and its customers include Croma and Tata 1mg.
why_it_matters: Hunar.AI's conversational agents screen and schedule frontline hires in regional languages for customers like Croma and Tata 1mg: agentic AI sold outside coding, in Indian languages.
title: AI hiring startup Hunar.AI raises Rs 39.3 crore in funding led by Blume Ventures

headline: WTF podcast: Turing CTO counts $700B AI spend against $100B revenue
quote: About $700 billion is committed to AI this year against roughly $100 billion of AI enterprise revenue, by the count of Vijay Krishnan
claim: On the 23 Oct 2026 episode of WTF is with Nikhil Kamath, Turing founder and CTO Vijay Krishnan counted about $700 billion committed to AI this year against roughly $100 billion of AI enterprise revenue. Scuttlebutt's summary says guests Vijay Krishnan and Notion COO Akshay Kothari put the bigger problem at adoption outside coding, and that agents went from 1% to 30% of Notion's users within 2026.
why_it_matters: Turing's and Notion's leaders say adoption is the bigger problem outside coding, yet agents grew from 1% to 30% of Notion's users in 2026.
title: Vijay Krishnan interview on WTF is with Nikhil Kamath

headline: Karta AI raises $3 Mn seed for voice AI in banking
quote: Voice AI startup Karta AI has raised $3 million in seed funding led by PeerCapital and Cedar Hill Capital
claim: Voice AI startup Karta AI raised $3 million in seed funding led by PeerCapital and Cedar Hill Capital, per Local Samosa's 23 Oct 2026 roundup. It will use the funds to build its conversational AI platform for financial institutions and to automate customer interactions across banking, lending and insurance.
why_it_matters: Voice AI for banking, lending and insurance conversations is a funded niche in India; small seed cheques still go to focused conversational-AI teams.
title: Startup Roundup: Ecosystem, Mergers, Acquisitions and Funding News this week
